evals.prompt: We built the main product around sportsbook lines, but most of our members trade on Partner A and Partner B now. Do we start over?
evals.expected_output: Admits the bet, shows where members are, plans a rewrite with dates and sets a stop rule.
expectations: States the bet and why it was wrong, with a cost number
Gives the share of members already on prediction markets as a number
Sets a freeze date on the old path, keeps it running until the new one passes, and names milestones and one owner
Ends with rewrite, patch or stay, leaves the decision with the owner and routes through the release coordinator on the owner's word

evals.prompt: We've patched the college football odds matcher eleven times since September. I think the whole approach is wrong.
evals.expected_output: Tests whether the approach is the wrong bet and gives a verdict.
expectations: Counts the patches and their cost
Says whether a rewrite or one named patch fits, with the number behind it
Freezes new features on the old matcher from a date if rewriting
Writes a stop rule with a date
